# winfsp-sys (vendored)

Vendored 2026-10-28 from the published [`winfsp-sys` crate 0.12.1](https://crates.io/crates/winfsp-sys)
(upstream: <https://github.com/SnowflakePowered/winfsp-rs>, license GPL-3.0).

**Why vendored:** the published crate's `build.rs` runs bindgen at build time,
which requires libclang. This copy replaces code generation with the crate's
own pre-generated bindings and keeps the bundled import libraries, so the
build is hermetic: **no libclang, no WinFSP install**. WinFSP remains a
runtime-only dependency. Note: the final binary carries an *immediate*
import of `winfsp-x64.dll` — `rustc-link-arg` from a transitive dependency's
build script is not propagated to the final link (verified 2026-10-28), so
the upstream `/DELAYLOAD`+`delayimp` directives kept below are inert here and
the DLL must be resolvable on the process's DLL search path at startup (e.g.
copied next to the executable, or WinFSP's `bin` directory on `PATH`). On a
standard WinFSP 2.x install the DLL lives in
`C:\Program Files (x86)\WinFsp\bin`, which is *not* a default search path.

**What is in this copy**

| Path | From the published crate |
|---|---|
| `src/bindings.rs` | `src/bindings.rs`, copied verbatim (pregenerated by rust-bindgen 0.72.0, the version the published build script pins) |
| `winfsp/lib/*.lib` | bundled MSVC import libraries (x64, x86, a64) |
| `src/lib.rs` | same crate-level allows and `u32` type aliases, but `include!` points at the local `bindings.rs` and the docs.rs-only `mod bindings` block is dropped (it would duplicate the included items) |
| `build.rs` | same link directives as upstream (link-search of `winfsp/lib`, `delayimp`, `dylib=winfsp-<arch>`, `/DELAYLOAD:winfsp-<arch>.dll`, same triple table), kept for fidelity; only the `dylib=winfsp-<arch>` library and the search path are effective for downstream binaries (see note above); bindgen, header include, and the registry-lookup `system` path are removed |
| `Cargo.toml` | same name/version/lib name; build-dependencies removed; `docsrs` and `system` kept as no-op features so winfsp 0.13.x's feature map still resolves |

Not copied: `winfsp/inc/` (bindgen headers), `winfsp/bin/` (driver DLLs —
the runtime comes from the user's WinFSP install), pkg-config files,
upstream `Cargo.lock`/`.cargo*` artifacts.

**To revert:** delete this folder and the `[patch.crates-io]` entry in the
root `Cargo.toml`; restoring the published crate then requires libclang
(Windows: install LLVM) at build time.
